driver-layers.title: Three layers, one of them yours
driver-layers.alt: Layer diagram: the application calls the hardware-agnostic sfm::Driver and its commands, which use the CRTP I2C interface, which calls the platform port you write, which drives the I2C bus of the Sensirion SFM4300 or another SF06-family flow meter.
driver-layers.description: From top to bottom. Your application talks to one sfm::Driver<I2c> object per sensor, whose public commands are listed from inc/sfm_driver.hpp. The core turns each call into 16-bit SF06 commands, checks the CRC-8 of every word it reads and converts raw counts with the scaling the sensor reported. The communication interface (sfm::I2cInterface in inc/sfm_i2c_interface.hpp) is a CRTP base: four methods are required, general call is optional. The platform port is the only code you write. Below it is the sensor.
